<!-- AUTOGENERATED by eng/DocsGen. Do not edit; run `dotnet run --project eng/DocsGen`. -->

Every invocation returns one of the codes below. The code identifies the class of failure, so a script can branch on it without parsing output.

| Code | Name | Meaning | Raised as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | `Success` | The command completed. | — |
| `1` | `ValidationError` | An option, argument, or configuration file failed validation. | `CliValidationException` |
| `2` | `IoError` | A file or directory could not be read or written. | `CliIOException` |
| `3` | `ProcessError` | An external command returned a non-zero exit code. | `CliProcessException` |
| `4` | `TemplateError` | A template could not be found, parsed, or rendered. | `CliTemplateException` |
| `5` | `ConfigurationError` | Configuration was missing or could not be understood. | `CliConfigurationException` |
| `6` | `PluginError` | A plugin failed to load, or a generation strategy threw. | `CliPluginException` |
| `7` | `SchemaError` | Input did not match its schema. | `CliSchemaException` |
| `8` | `Cancelled` | The run was cancelled before it completed. | `CliCancelledException`, `OperationCanceledException` |
| `99` | `UnexpectedError` | An unanticipated failure. Re-run with `--verbose`. | any other exception |

## Notes

- `8` is returned when the run is interrupted with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>C</kbd>. Files already written are left in place.
- `99` indicates a failure the tool did not anticipate. Re-run with `--verbose` to see the stack trace, and please report it.
